bills.summary: Tightens the fiscal framework (LC 200) with extra spending-control measures.
Creates incentives and benefits for sports activities.
Approves Congress's review of the National Defence Policy and Strategy.
Says the service tax (ISS) on hoisting and towing services is due where the work is done.
Sets general rules for resolving tax disputes by agreement and for tax administrative procedure.
Restructures federal judges' posts in the 1st Region and creates a new appeals panel in Piauí.
Suspends a resolution of the national children's rights council (CONANDA).
Temporarily moves the federal government's seat to Belém during COP30.
Changes the Aldir Blanc national culture funding policy.
Creates a national programme for sustainable and resilient infrastructure.
Extends the deadline to settle unprocessed carry-over budget commitments, including parliamentary amendments.
Gives states and municipalities more time to reprogram transfers.
Renames a meeting room in the Chamber of Deputies.
Creates a national registry of football teams sanctioned for racism.
Exempts lower incomes from income tax and creates a minimum tax on very high incomes.
Authorises creation of a foundation by the state bank Caixa.
Creates new federal civil-service careers and changes pay of federal employees.
Votes on suspending a criminal case against a sitting deputy.
Converts vacant posts at a regional labour court without extra cost.
Lets the state bank Banco do Nordeste create subsidiaries.
Creates a benefits-management programme at the social security institute INSS.
Reallocates public-security powers between the Union, states and municipalities.
Names a viaduct in Aparecida, São Paulo.
Creates a fund for the federal public prosecution service.
Creates a national early-childhood development strategy.
Gives the oil regulator ANP access to tax information of regulated firms.
Overturns the government decree that raised the IOF financial tax.
Approves Brazil's accession to a multilateral investment fund.
Creates the 'Agora Tem Especialistas' specialist-care programme.
Changes the staff plan and careers of the federal audit court (TCU).
Votes on whether a convicted deputy should lose her mandate.
Creates commissioned functions at the Superior Court of Justice.
Converts vacant posts at a regional labour court without extra cost.
Changes electricity and oil-sector laws through a provisional measure.
Excludes temporary education and health spending from the fiscal-framework limits.
Creates special environmental licensing for strategic projects.
Sets the official export-credit support system.
Lets deaf people's disability be shown on the identity card.
Sets the composition and posts of the 5th Region federal court.
Speeds up criminal procedure after arrests in the act.
Renames the gas aid 'Auxílio Gás do Povo' and changes how it is delivered.
Creates a Taxpayer Defence Code.
Creates a data-protection regulatory career and the national data protection agency's structure.
Changes the careers of federal judiciary staff.
Votes on suspending a criminal case against a sitting deputy.
Guarantees free carry-on baggage for air passengers.
Creates the general law on environmental licensing.
Sets rules for strategic national-defence projects.
Elects a member of the National Council of Justice.
Creates posts and commissioned functions at the National Council of Justice.
